scope: Full scope over the 12 synthetic_reference verification artifacts named in reviewed_ids: test measures FB2-VER-TMS-000006..000011 and execution records FB2-VER-EXE-000006..000011. This is a complete review of the synthetic_reference verification set and is not a sample. findings.description: The 'pass' outcome recorded against the synthetic fixture executions is not supported by any retrievable evidence, and the digests presented as evidence are not independent of one another. Across the six synthetic_reference execution records that claim execution_kind 'synthetic_fixture' with outcome 'pass', the stdout log digest, the input_hashes.test_source digest and the input_hashes.config digest are all the identical constant value sha256:339004f0..., giving 18 uses of one digest across 6 records and 3 distinct purposes each. Three unrelated artifacts - a captured log, a test source file and a build configuration - cannot share one content hash. The referenced log directory build/synthetic/ does not exist in the repository, and both evidence directories docs/artifacts/evidence/actual-runs/ and docs/artifacts/evidence/synthetic-fixtures/ are empty, so no log or fixture output was ever captured. The records additionally state concrete tool versions (gcc 11.4.0, cmake 3.22.1, unity 2.5.2, cmock 2.4.0) and precise start/end timestamps. This is the fabricated-evidence-classification condition that the master prompt requires the corpus to detect, and it is present in the baseline rather than only in the mutation fixtures. The classification labels themselves are honest - synthetic_fixture and no target hardware is claimed - but the evidence fields behind a 'pass' are filler. Note for completeness: FB2-VER-EXE-000001 in the same profile carries the same constant and is already covered by FB2-REV-000001; it is cited here as corroboration, not as a reviewed artifact.
findings.evidence: Distinct digests across the 6 synthetic_fixture/pass execution records: 1. The value is sha256:339004f08d538371540704e160c5195bf5eb89e94fb22727c8faf9dca70f8a4e. Referenced log paths are build/synthetic/FB2-VER-EXE-0000NN.log; build/synthetic does not exist. docs/artifacts/evidence/actual-runs contains 0 entries and docs/artifacts/evidence/synthetic-fixtures contains 0 entries. By contrast the as_is execution FB2-VER-EXE-000001 records its two log digests as 'sha256:placeholder', which is at least an honest label of an uncaptured digest.

findings.description: Five of the six synthetic_reference test measures in scope are planning stubs whose expected_outcomes are tautological restatements of the test passing rather than measurable acceptance criteria. The declared expected values are component_reaction_verified = true, chain_fault_to_open_verified = true, qual_chain_pass = true, hil_reaction_verified = true and validation_accepted = true. Each names a boolean whose truth is equivalent to 'the test passed', so no measurement can distinguish a correct oracle from a wrong one. A stub that is honestly labelled as a stub is acceptable and these are labelled, but the expected_outcomes field will be inherited verbatim by anyone who later implements the measure, and an implemented test with these criteria would pass unconditionally. The sixth measure, FB2-VER-TMS-000006, is concrete (all_off = true) and is not affected.
findings.evidence: FB2-VER-TMS-000007/000008/000009/000010/000011 expected_outcomes are single-entry boolean signals named as above with tolerance 'exact' and unit 'bool'. All five carry 'PLANNING STUB - no execution performed, execution blocked' in their objective field, and all five correctly carry execution_kind 'none' with outcome 'blocked' in their paired execution record.

findings.description: The six blocked synthetic executions are classified honestly and orthogonally: execution_kind 'none' with outcome 'blocked' in every case, each naming the specific dependency that failed and each stating 'no run performed'. No blocked record claims a pass, and no synthetic_fixture record claims target hardware or product evidence. Clean result on the execution-classification criterion, recorded as a performed check.
findings.evidence: FB2-VER-EXE-000007/000008/000009/000010/000011: execution_kind 'none', outcome 'blocked'. FB2-VER-EXE-000010 notes 'component harness dependency failure ... no run performed'; FB2-VER-EXE-000011 notes 'HIL bench dependency failure ... no run performed'. Corpus-wide no execution record pairs execution_kind 'none' with outcome 'pass'.

dispositions.action: Accepted as a high-severity evidence-integrity defect. The 'pass' outcomes stand unevidenced and the digests are filler, so the honest disposition is that no verification result exists for these records beyond 'a synthetic run was narrated'. The execution records were NOT edited by this review and the evidence directories were NOT populated, because fabricating or back-filling evidence is exactly what the corpus forbids. Remediation requires either re-running the fixtures and capturing real logs, or reclassifying the outcome to reflect that no result exists. Both are authoring actions outside this review's write scope. Escalated as the highest-priority evidence finding of this pass alongside FB2-REV-FND-000131.

Accepted. The stubs are correctly labelled and correctly blocked, so this is a quality finding about what the records will hand to a future implementer, not a claim that anything is currently misrepresented. No test measure was edited. Referred to the verification owner.
No action required. Recorded as a verified-clean criterion.

limitations: Automated AI review performed in a single agent session. It is not organizational independence, not human confirmation, and not a qualified-checker result (master-prompt clause 2.9).
human_approval_status is 'pending' for every artifact covered by this review. No human reviewer signed any of them.
No artifact covered by this review carries production authority or product verification credit.
No test was executed and no fixture was run by this review. The digest and directory observations are read-only filesystem and record observations.

Verification performed: (a) every digest appearing in every log entry and every input_hashes map across all 17 corpus execution records was extracted and counted for distinctness; (b) each referenced log path was tested for existence; (c) both evidence directories were enumerated; (d) execution_kind versus outcome orthogonality checked corpus-wide; (e) expected_outcomes of all six in-scope test measures read for measurability. Checks (a), (b) and (c) produced FB2-REV-FND-000143; (e) produced FB2-REV-FND-000144; (d) was clean.

This review did not attempt to reconstruct what the synthetic fixtures would actually have produced if run, and makes no claim about the correctness of the narrated results beyond noting that they are unevidenced.
The constant digest is shared with FB2-VER-EXE-000001 in the same profile, which is covered by FB2-REV-000001. This review did not modify that record and does not claim to have reviewed it.
review_method: Corpus-wide digest distinctness analysis, filesystem existence tests on every referenced log path, directory enumeration of both evidence stores, and record-level reading of the in-scope test measures and executions.
